changes: Binds owned network ID and API/Web/gateway endpoint memberships and IPs before operation.
Checks exact gateway ID/image/owner/project/service and active runtime config SHA equal to the public template.
Captures fixed local API/Web/gateway route status and expected public Web policy/JS hash booleans only after a public 502 and before any nginx command.

Repeats the complete public probe set only after the one guarded reload; any failed condition returns to the existing guarded rollback.
Suppresses Set-OriginBytesCAS return values to keep stdout terminal JSON only; preserves original 502 route/status/exit in recovery receipt.
